boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Skidmore spaces documented by College and library sources for studying, meeting, making, eating, reflection, or outdoor recreation.

cards.title: Lucy Scribner Library
cards.subtitle: Central campus research and collaboration space
cards.notes: Start here when your group needs a shared work base: use the library’s study areas, then connect with research, technology, or writing help in the building.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub with study rooms, carrels, collections, and academic-support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore says the library provides research and collaboration space and added seating areas, study carrels, and group study rooms in its 2012 renovation.
cards.source_title: About the Library | Lucy Scribner Library
cards.access_notes: Library access and service availability may vary; check the library before visiting.

cards.title: Creative Corridor
cards.subtitle: First floor, Lucy Scribner Library
cards.notes: Bring a collaborative assignment to the library’s first-floor Creative Corridor, where flexible group seating is intended to support conversation and shared work.
cards.short_summary: A flexible library setting designed around collaboration and creativity.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore’s catalog identifies the Creative Corridor as group and flexible space with seating intended to foster student collaboration and creativity.
cards.access_notes: Located in Lucy Scribner Library; use the library’s current access information.

cards.title: Philip Boshoff Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Fourth floor, Lucy Scribner Library
cards.notes: Use a peer consultation to discuss a draft at any stage; the center is a dedicated fourth-floor library space with student tutors and a welcoming setup.
cards.short_summary: A peer-run writing resource where students can meet one-on-one with trained tutors.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore reports that the peer-run Philip Boshoff Writing Center on the library’s fourth floor provides one-on-one consultations for students across class years and majors.
cards.source_title: Pairing learning with community in the peer-run Philip Boshoff Writing Center
cards.access_notes: Consultation availability is set by the Writing Center; check its current appointment information.

cards.title: Case College Center
cards.subtitle: Campus meeting and student-activity hub
cards.notes: Use Case as a practical meetup point before a club meeting or campus errand; it combines student-organization offices, services, food, and social space.
cards.short_summary: A central community building with student-club offices, campus services, and gathering areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore describes Case College Center as a meeting place and hub of student activity housing student-club offices, the bookstore, post office, gallery, and cafés.
cards.access_notes: Building services and individual offices have separate hours.

cards.title: Intercultural Center and Intercultural Lounge
cards.subtitle: Case Center
cards.notes: Check the Intercultural Center calendar for programs, workshops, and exhibits, or arrange a meeting connected to one of the student organizations that uses the space.
cards.short_summary: A Case Center meeting and programming space for intercultural and interfaith exchange.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore identifies the Intercultural Center as a Case Center meeting place for multiple student organizations and a site for programs, workshops, exhibits, and interfaith activities.
cards.access_notes: Programs and lounge use can be scheduled; contact the Intercultural Center for current details.

cards.title: Porter Plaza
cards.subtitle: South side of Case College Center
cards.notes: Meet outdoors at Porter Plaza for a conversation between activities, and watch the campus calendar for social gatherings, special events, or performances there.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor Case Center gathering area used for socializing and campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore’s catalog identifies Porter Plaza, on the south side of Case Center, as an outdoor gathering space for socializing, special events, and performances.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor use is weather-dependent; event setups may change availability.

cards.title: Burgess Café
cards.subtitle: Case College Center
cards.notes: Pair a focused study session with a café table in Case Center; the College specifically describes Burgess as combining computer access with social and study space.
cards.short_summary: A Case Center café setting that combines computer access, study space, and social space.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore’s catalog says Burgess Café offers computer access together with study and social space in a coffeehouse setting.
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks require purchase; consult Dining Services for current café hours.

cards.title: Murray-Aikins Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: Dining hall facing Case Green
cards.notes: Plan a meal with classmates and use the dining hall’s varied stations or seating; the facility also has space for campus gatherings and student feedback events.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining venue with multiple food stations, lounge seating, and event space.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore documents Murray-Aikins as a dining facility with multiple cuisine stations, lounge space, wireless internet, and first- and second-floor space for events.
cards.access_notes: Meals require a meal plan or payment; check Dining Services for current hours and access.

cards.title: North Woods
cards.subtitle: 150-acre woodland on the edge of campus
cards.notes: Use the North Woods for a daytime walk on its trails, and look for academic or outdoor programming that makes use of its historic and ecological landscape.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge woodland with hiking trails, recreation, and opportunities for field-based learning.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore describes the 150-acre North Woods as offering miles of hiking trails and recreational opportunities for students, including archaeology fieldwork at the historic Denton homesite.
cards.source_title: Unearthing history in Skidmore’s North Woods
cards.access_notes: Stay on designated trails and follow College guidance; conditions vary by season and weather.

cards.title: Wilson Chapel
cards.subtitle: By the North Woods, near Palamountain and Tisch
cards.notes: Use the chapel’s scheduled Chill Space hours for a quiet break, study time, meditation, or prayer; check Religious and Spiritual Life for drop-in availability.
cards.short_summary: A quiet campus chapel used for open, student-staffed reflection and study time.
cards.evidence_claim: Skidmore’s Religious and Spiritual Life schedule lists Chill Space at Wilson Chapel for hanging out, taking a break, studying, meditating, or praying, with no RSVP required.
cards.source_title: Religious and Spiritual Life | Skidmore College
cards.access_notes: Check the Religious and Spiritual Life schedule; the chapel is available for drop-in use when open and not reserved.
